referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Michael Auto website in London, England uses near-black text-led opening punctuated by a compact yellow action. Navigation is short dark header with phone and WhatsApp. Its page moves through type-led opening, service overview, review proof, owner story, three-step process, area and directions, direct contact, with three major service buckets rather than a large icon catalogue. one real workshop image supports an otherwise type-led narrative. Transferable mechanics are black-yellow type hero, three-step process, direct phone close. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
